title: Alpentherme Ehrenberg Reutte
highlights: First-rate thermal and sauna resort overlooking the Ehrenberg castle ensemble
Outdoor brine pool featuring a lazy river current and 34°C warm water
Exciting Alpenbob tire slide providing high-speed downhill action
Award-winning sauna village with panorama sauna and natural swimming pond
kurzbeschreibung: The Alpentherme Ehrenberg in Reutte offers soothing brine pools, water slide fun, and an award-winning sauna landscape.
beschreibung:
Wellness and Bathing Fun in the Außerfern

The Alpentherme Ehrenberg in Reutte is a modern bathing and wellness resort set amidst the Lechtaler Alpen. With direct views of the historic Ehrenberg castle ruins and the highline179 pedestrian suspension bridge, the thermal bath offers the ideal respite for body and mind.

Brine Landscape and Sauna Village

The thermal water in the 34-degree heated outdoor brine pool relaxes muscles and joints. The Alpenbob tyre slide brings plenty of action, while toddlers can splash about in the dedicated children's area. The expansive sauna paradise boasts themed saunas, relaxation rooms, and an idyllic natural bathing pond.
